reviews.name: mayor of Frosinone Italian politician
reviews.identity: The mayor of Frosinone, an Italian politician, died on May 31, 2022. As mayor, the officeholder served as an elected member of the Frosinone City Council and shared responsibility, with the council, for the strategic government of Frosinone in Lazio, Italy. Under the Italian Constitution, the mayor of Frosinone is also a member of the City Council. The current mayor is Riccardo Mastrangeli (FI), who took office on 29 June 2022.

reviews.name: Killing of Monique and Spencer Tepe American dentist, shot
reviews.identity: Monique Tepe, an American dentist, was shot dead on December 30, 2025, alongside her husband, Spencer Tepe, in their Columbus, Ohio, home. The couple were found after Spencer failed to arrive for work and a welfare check was requested. Their two young children and family dog were discovered unharmed. The investigation focused on Monique Tepe’s ex-husband, Michael David McKee, who was arrested in Illinois on January 10, 2026, and later indicted in Franklin County on four counts of aggravated murder and one count of aggravated burglary. Criminal proceedings remain ongoing.
